changelog.title: The Code Armory
changelog.description: 16 programming language tracks with 160+ modules. From Python to Assembly, beginner to advanced. Includes a language comparison tool and recommendation engine.

changelog.title: Platform Integrity
changelog.description: Comprehensive security enhancements across the platform. Improved answer validation, enhanced session monitoring, and strengthened content protection.

changelog.title: CTF Operations
changelog.description: Expanded capture-the-flag scenarios across both offensive and defensive tracks. New troubleshooting boxes for hardware, OS recovery, and printer diagnostics.

changelog.title: Admin Console
changelog.description: Platform management dashboard for instructors. User administration, handler code assignment, account operations, and system health monitoring.

changelog.title: Signal Toolkit Library
changelog.description: 20-page deep-dive reference library covering hardware tools, security utilities, and field preparation guides.

changelog.title: Accessibility & Compliance
changelog.description: WCAG AA color contrast fixes, ARIA labels, and keyboard navigation across core UI components. Ongoing accessibility improvements planned.

changelog.title: AI Assistant
changelog.description: Built-in chatbot for student support. Context-aware help, platform navigation, and learning guidance available from the dashboard.

changelog.title: Learning Path Alignment
changelog.description: All content modules wired into structured learning paths. Zero unchained files across the entire platform.
